summary_en: 57,000 shares (0.61% of shares outstanding) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on June 17, 2026 at opening. Upper limit ¥100M. Price reference: ¥1,653 (June 16 close). Shareholder HKY has signalled willingness to sell.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares and purchase of treasury shares via off-exchange trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On June 16, 2026, Ocean System Corporation's board resolved to acquire treasury shares under the Companies Act. The company will conduct a single-block purchase of up to 57,000 shares (0.61% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) via ToSTNeT-3 off-exchange trading at the market open on June 17, 2026 at 8:45 a.m. The upper limit on acquisition is ¥100M. The purchase price reference is ¥1,653, the prior day's closing price. The company states the acquisition aims to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency for flexible capital deployment in response to future business environment changes. Notably, shareholder HKY has communicated its willingness to respond with sales of its Ocean System shares. Results will be announced immediately after the trading window closes.
